description: Cheapest fleet-wide maintenance check; takes no parameters. Returns an object keyed by printer id, each entry holding status (in_maintenance, due, scheduled, or operational when only problems are open), next_scheduled_date and open_problems (the number of reported problems not yet resolved). Only printers with a scheduled or in-progress job or an open problem appear, so a printer that is absent has nothing outstanding and an empty object means nothing is scheduled or reported anywhere. Follow up with get_printer_maintenance_profile for one printer, or list_maintenance_jobs for job-level detail.
name: get_maintenance_status_map
